deck.ko: 헌책 노점 앞에서 오래 머물러도 따뜻한 가죽과 코듀로이 차림.
deck.en: Leather and corduroy warm enough for a long browse at the bookstall.
deck.de: Leder und Cord, warm genug für langes Stöbern am Bücherstand.

intro.ko: 흐린 오후, 헌책 노점 주인과 이야기가 길어집니다. 시어링 소매와 비니가 찬 공기를 막아 주어 책장을 넘기는 손만 바쁩니다.
intro.en: On a grey afternoon the chat with the bookseller runs long. Shearling cuffs and a beanie keep the cold out, so only the hands turning pages stay busy.
intro.de: An einem grauen Nachmittag wird das Gespräch mit dem Buchhändler länger. Lammfellbündchen und Beanie halten die Kälte ab, nur die Hände blättern.

body.ko: 그레이 프린지 스카프까지 더해 목과 몸통을 따뜻하게 감쌉니다.
body.en: Finish the layers with gray fringed scarf.

tip.ko: 갈색 가죽, 버건디 코듀로이, 회색 니트처럼 질감이 다른 세 가지를 겹치면 색을 더하지 않아도 풍성해 보여요.
tip.en: Stack three textures — brown leather, burgundy cord, grey knit — and the look feels rich without adding more colour.
tip.de: Drei Texturen kombinieren – braunes Leder, bordeauxroter Cord, grauer Strick –, dann wirkt der Look reich, ohne mehr Farbe.

ko.deck: 시어링 트리밍 브라운 가죽 재킷에 그레이 리브 니트을 겹친 초겨울 캐주얼.
ko.intro: 기온 6°C, 체감 3°C의 흐린 낮을 위한 차림입니다.
ko.tip: 니트 위에 입고 앞섶을 살짝 열어 레이어를 보여주세요.

en.deck: Brown shearling-trim leather jacket over gray ribbed knit sweater for an early-winter casual look.
en.intro: For an overcast day at 6°C that feels like 3°C.
en.tip: Wear it over knitwear and leave the front slightly open to show the layer.

de.deck: Braune Lederjacke mit Lammfellbesatz über Grauer Rippstrickpullover für einen lässigen Start in den Winter.
de.intro: Für einen bedeckten Tag bei 6 °C, gefühlt 3 °C.
de.tip: Über Strick tragen und vorne leicht offen lassen, damit die Schicht sichtbar bleibt.

copy.rewriteReason: b222 Claude Code copy rewrite under design/IMAGE_MAPPING_HANDOFF.md 5-1: delivered intro and tip were one sentence for all 10 looks (tip = the outer's how-to-wear), product how-to-wear used 9 template sentences for 66 products, decks listed product names (ko particle error '니트을', de case errors). Titles, pulls, bodies and product names/descriptions are kept verbatim; rewritten fields keep the delivered text in source* fields. Written from the 10 approved editorials.
